method: Nolane AGI cognitive-method discipline applied to engineering; not an AGI capability claim

belief_updates.belief: Higher repository value comes from precision and selective source paging, not from indexing more text.
belief_updates.rival: Broad retrieval may be safer because narrow retrieval can miss dependencies.

belief_updates.belief: Static semantic precision can supersede weak call edges.
belief_updates.rival: A precise result at one call-site may not justify removing all weak facts from the caller.
belief_updates.probe: mixed resolved/unresolved calls in the same function.
belief_updates.observation: Initial whole-caller supersession deleted unresolved call evidence.
belief_updates.status: rejected coarse variant; corrected to exact call-site supersession

belief_updates.belief: Provider partitions can avoid whole-domain semantic traversal on body-only changes.
belief_updates.rival: Cross-file resolution may require broad invalidation whenever any source byte changes.

belief_updates.belief: Top retrieval score alone can calibrate confidence.
belief_updates.rival: A common single term can dominate a multi-concept no-gold task.
belief_updates.probe: quantum banana teleportation matrix against AGI corpus.
belief_updates.observation: Initial query became high-confidence because matrix was common.

belief_updates.belief: Exact lexical concept coverage is sufficient.
belief_updates.rival: Source identifiers encode morphological variants and exact lexical coverage underestimates real support.
belief_updates.observation: Exact coverage was 2/3 despite correct semantic target.
belief_updates.status: rejected; indexed identifier morphology added with no source reads

belief_updates.belief: Context memory should expose bounded exact source only on demand.
belief_updates.rival: Materializing full selected files is simpler and may avoid page faults.
belief_updates.probe: virtual address-space + digest-bound prefetch in end-to-end demo.

belief_updates.belief: Interoperability should not force core protocol dependency.
belief_updates.rival: Making MCP the core protocol would simplify one integration path.
belief_updates.observation: Core works without MCP; adapter registers a compact high-level surface under SDK contract double and fails clearly if SDK is absent.
belief_updates.status: retained; real SDK runtime not admitted on this host

negative_results_preserved: inactive evidence leaked through FTS before active-state gate
Jedi overlay initially superseded unresolved same-caller calls
provider API-surface fingerprint initially invalidated on body-only text
AGI no-gold query initially false-high due common term matrix
identifier morphology initially caused false-low demo confidence

claim_boundary: Evidence establishes bounded mechanisms on included fixtures/corpus. It does not establish universal token reduction, coding-success uplift, production isolation, universal semantic precision, or AGI capability.
